text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright, fraying repaired.
Nothing else wrong... I think!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu's racing outfit is
simple, but it's really cute~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Thanks! I really like it myself too~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Calm and composed,
yet always full of energy.
I guess that's the kind of person I want to be.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
All that time worrying over the design was totally worth it~
Though I left the finishing touches to the designer, of course.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"It suits you, it really suits you.
It feels so very Dants~."

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Still, don't you kinda admire flashy stuff, too? Like, standing out is what it's all about. I'm pretty plain myself, so...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Flashy... standing out...

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Something that won't blend into the crowd.
Unique, flashy, and eye-catching.
If I get another chance, maybe I'll give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
......
Brimming with individuality...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Something that won't get lost in the crowd...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. Compared to everyone else,
maybe I really am a bit too calm...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (Flashiness or something like that... maybe I should have incorporated it?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I really like this one.
It's not about being flashy or anything..."

text_block_list.name: Troubled Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Dantsu~ help me~.
I can't handle this on my own~.

text_block_list.name: Worried Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm in a real bind.
Hey, Dantsu. Could you give me some advice...?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Truth is...
I also wanted to make it approachable...
so everyone would feel comfortable relying on me.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Instead of changing your Racewear, what if you tried changing your attitude...?
For example—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
How truly magnificent... Even the sun itself
seems poised to bow before my brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hah! To think the deep veil of night would be my invitation.
Come... the light of the heavens is lost.
—Now, reveal the pitch-black guidance!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right. The sky over there is getting a bit cloudy...
Wait, that's not what you meant.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Those two might make good references...
If I can carry myself with dignity like that,
even in this racing outfit—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaa!
Even the sun was shocked by my sparkle!
It's gone completely into hiding!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's make this an awesome party!
We're gonna fight alongside formidable rivals, baby!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
…………
E-Even just in my imagination, that might have been impossible.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
After all, I can only ever be... myself.
If I want to show a change,
it'd pretty much have to be through my outfit...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“...I wonder if I should have gone
with something more 'lead-character-like'...”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Was what I had been thinking, at least.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Worrying over something like this
is totally unlike a protagonist... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Geez... I always end up
overthinking such little things—
Even small worries and feelings will one day become parts of your past self, forming a piece of the leading role's... the protagonist's journey.
choice_data_list: You don't need to worry about not feeling like a proper star.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Is that really how it is?
"Isn't that what makes someone the star—the true protagonist?"
That's why—
choice_data_list: It's okay for Dantsu to just be herself.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for comforting me.
You're right, I should just be myself... Forcing myself to change won't—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Dants Frame's gonna be the star, right?
Dants Frame is going to be the star, isn't she?

text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Whatever the outfit may be, it makes no difference.

Because whatever Dantsu Flame chooses
will one day become the
"Racewear chosen by the protagonist" in the future.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: The Racewear chosen by the leading lady——...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...I see, that makes sense.
No matter what racewear I'm wearing...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
—If I can't win,
I can't become the leading lady I aspire to be.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Then...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer.
For making me realize that.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It might still be far off right now, but...
one day, for sure.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll make this racing outfit
fit for the leading star...!
